fact: The Lagos State Domestic and Sexual Violence Agency announced on 24 February 2025 Ask INU, a WhatsApp-based AI chatbot giving survivors immediate information and referrals.

The Federal Ministry of Communications, Innovation and Digital Economy says it launched GovGuide Nigeria with Meta, NCAIR and Publica AI, a fully operational voice and text AI chatbot on the web giving information on government services in English, Hausa, Igbo and Yoruba.

Head of the Civil Service Didi Esther Walson-Jack said the federal Service-Wise GPT platform, an AI tool helping civil servants navigate service rules and institutional knowledge, has recorded over 50,000 conversations.

ITWeb Africa reports Nigeria launched GovGuideNigeria, an AI platform giving real-time conversational answers on immigration procedures, documents and public programmes via WhatsApp and the web in English, Hausa, Igbo and Yoruba.
ITWeb Africa says GovGuideNigeria consolidates information from more than 35 federal ministries and over 60 government agencies.

PRNigeria reports that the Head of the Civil Service of the Federation announced the deployment of a Service-Wide GPT trained on the Constitution, Public Service Rules and circulars, which has recorded over 25,000 chats.
PRNigeria reports the Head of the Civil Service of the Federation saying the Service-Wide GPT, with over 25,000 chats, shows growing adoption across Ministries, Departments and Agencies.
